task: Give each global CodeMie CLI profile its own CodeMie identity (codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration) with a safe upgrade path that never clones the leftover shared project into every profile, a visible warning/prompt for profiles without a project, and the project shown in the launch banner and `codemie profile` output (EPMCDME-16519 / EPMCDME-15411).

key_reasoning.reason: Spans 4+ subsystems: ProviderProfile type, core ConfigLoader (load, resolveProfileWorkspaceWithOrigin, saveProfile, loadWithSources, resolveIdentitySource), a new migration (id >= 010), CLI profile list/status display and setup save path, the agent launch banner (renderProfileInfo/BaseAgentAdapter), evidence project_source (stamp.ts), and the standalone Claude statusline mirror. Downstream template/plugin/proxy readers are consumers only. Base L, bumped to XL by the core-shared-utility red flag (ConfigLoader).

Problem and root cause are confirmed, but the direction is explicitly 'to be confirmed in spec': the upgrade policy (active profile only vs. provable cases vs. none), the warning vs. one-time prompt behaviour, read-time fallback to workspace.codeMieProject, and an optional launcher --project override are all open design decisions with rework risk.

Closest pattern is reverted PR #701 (71093df1): atomic identity trio, saveProfile carry-forward, per-profile list display, statusline mirror. It does not cover the new upgrade/fallback policy (its canUseSharedIdentity guard passed same-URL profiles, reproducing the bug) and changes the derivation source of X-CodeMie-Project/-Integration, which the security guide marks CRITICAL. Budget misattribution is silent and costly; shortcut launchers and statusline skip migrations; open PRs #753/#667/#575 overlap config.ts. Base M (pattern exists), +1 security/attribution red flag, +1 data-migration red flag.

Roughly 8-12 source files (config.ts, types.ts, migrations/index.ts, setup.ts, profile/index.ts, display.ts, utils/profile.ts, BaseAgentAdapter.ts, stamp.ts, statusline.ts, possibly AgentCLI.ts and a guide) plus modified tests (config-project-override, profile index, statusline, seam/routing-contract) and new migration + migration test across 6+ directories: base XL, bumped to XXL by the data-migration red flag. Matches the project calibration example profile-provider-decoupling (XXL file change).

UI (CLI banner, profile list/status, setup prompt), Service (ConfigLoader resolution), DB-Persistence (config file schema change on ProviderProfile + migration), with the External attribution header as a downstream consumer: 3-4 layers including a persistence schema change, i.e. L. Not bumped further: adding three fields to ProviderProfile is not a significant schema overhaul.
